_readme: Andhra Pradesh SCHOOL EDUCATION Government Orders from the state's own Government Orders Issue Register, June 2014 to August 2026, covering three governments. Order COUNTS are complete. For money there is no single honest total, so three readings are carried and the platform shows all three rather than choosing: (A) the register's GO Amount column as published; (B) the same, except where an order's own text contradicts the column the order's wording wins; (C) B plus the orders whose column reads 0 although their text states a figure. Which government spent more depends on which reading you take. That is the finding, not a problem to tidy away.

source.name: Government Orders Issue Register (GOIR)
source.method: Portal Export of a search with Department = SCHOOL EDUCATION; all sections, G.O types and categories; NO keyword; dates 01-06-2014 to 28-08-2026. Searched by department and date rather than by scheme name on purpose: scheme names are party branding and searching one would surface one government's record while hiding the others.
source.access_note: The register refuses connections from outside India. Retrieved in-browser on an India route by the maintainer; document ids harvested from the result pages and joined to the export.

coverage.link_coverage_note: Every order without a document link has the subject 'Not Issued' — a G.O number reserved but never used, so no document exists. There are no orders whose document we simply failed to find.
coverage.telugu_note: Only 2 of 4,896 orders are published in Telugu. The state issues its school education orders almost entirely in English.
coverage.caveat: These are sanction and release ORDERS that happen to state a figure. They are a FLOOR, never departmental spending, and must not be merged with the Demands for Grants capital outlay series.
coverage.tenure_bucket_note: Four buckets, not three: two orders fall before the first post-bifurcation government took office on 8 June 2014 and are held separately so no government is credited with them. Bucket order counts sum exactly to orders_total.

tenures.label: Before the first post-bifurcation government
tenures.why_separate: Andhra Pradesh was bifurcated on 2 June 2014 and the first government of the residuary state was sworn in on 8 June 2014. These orders fall on or before 7 June 2014, so they belong to no elected government of the present state. They are kept separate rather than added to the first tenure, which would credit that government with money released before it existed.
